types.name: R_CANFD_CFDC_Type
types.note: BFT is not CRCT: the target bus-frame-transmit counter control is omitted rather than relabelled as the legacy CRC counter field.

types.name: R_CANFD_CFDGAFL_Type
types.note: P1 retains the stock raw register, but no GAFLFDP combined bitfield is invented across target-reserved bits 2–7. Target routes are bits 0, 1 and 8 only.

types.name: R_CANFD_Type
types.note: Two independent one-channel Lite units, not a two-channel shared-register peripheral. RX message buffers stop at 15 (two eight-buffer pages); reserved hardware and unsupported full-CANFD aliases are not exposed.
